}}'''Coladara''' is a [[Tairen]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Coladara}}

==History==

Coladara was born in Tear sometime between 925 and {{ne|940}}. 

She was an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]] during the final days of the [[Aiel War]] in {{ne|978}}.{{ref/book|0|4}} 

At some point prior to {{ne|998}}, she was made [[Aes Sedai advisors|advisor]] to King [[Paitar Nachiman]] of [[Arafel]]. They appear to have a close relationship. She is very fond of him.

==Activities==

When the White Tower split, she sided with neither [[Elaida]] nor the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Rebels]].{{ref/book|8|p}}

When Paitar went to the [[Black Hills]] to meet with the other Borderlander monarchs, he brought Coladara and seven other Aes Sedai with him. Paitar thought it unthinkable that he leave her behind.{{ref/book|8|p}} It is assumed that these other seven are also unaligned to any other faction and joined with Coladara.

Coladara was probably in [[Braem Wood]] when [[Elayne]] met the Borderland rulers there. Preparing for the meeting, [[Merilille]] told Elayne about the presence of some sisters with the Borderlanders, but Elayne did not meet any of them personally.

Coladara was probably in [[Far Madding]] during the meeting between the Borderland rulers and the [[Dragon Reborn]]. [[Cadsuane]] wanted to meet the thirteen Aes Sedai that are accompanying the Borderlanders, Coladara among them.{{ref/book|13|51}}

During the [[Last Battle]], Coladara fights in [[Shienar]] with the Borderlander armies; she goes because she insists on staying with King Paitar as his advisor.{{ref/book|14|9}} It is not stated whether she survived the battle or not.
